purpose: Identify the freshly generated revised meshes and strictly guarded reuse of unchanged model meshes in the completed normal source build.

unchanged_model_cache.cache_scope: Only hsr_components.build_models; FAN and MERGE always call the original writer.
unchanged_model_cache.purpose: Record guarded reuse of eleven accepted unchanged model meshes while the current normal builder regenerates every other resource and executes every required verifier.

generation_scope: Only model meshes for eleven unchanged types came from the accepted baseline cache. The original normal builder generated PATHs, shadows, exemplars, combined previews, effects, rules, menus, and archives for all thirteen types, and ran every ordinary saved-resource check. FAN and MERGE used their freshly generated current-source model configurations, retained in the compiler memory cache between this task’s builds.
reproduction: A contributor can instead run the documented ordinary source build with the exact supported NAM inputs; no private cache helper is required to generate or verify the source.
